payload.headline: The group discussed microphone replacements, file reorganization and disk space, Transcriber on NT, recognition experiments with the ICSI front-end, and detecting dead channels; it chose to buy two more Crown mikes.

actions.text: Buy two more of the Crown headset mikes and keep them available
Change the key file field from mike number to mike type and record Crown or Sony for each mike
Check with Morgan about buying another wireless system so all channels become wireless
Test the spare Shure mike and, if it works, replace the Andrea mike with it
Run the SRI front-end without vocal tract length normalization as a diagnostic experiment
Put the Transcriber and Channeltrans install in a central place with a sysadmin so it works on all NT machines
Hold a separate session to list all file reorganization and naming convention changes
Review the naming conventions Speaker C sent out
Follow up with Dave Johnson on why the backup disk's wave files appear accessed every night

decisions.text: Buy two more Crown mikes immediately as the first step to resolve the microphone shortage.
Shortening the segmented wave files is the short-term fix for disk space, requiring no coding.
Reorganize files by updating naming conventions and putting files on one disk, keeping old copies until the next full backup, then deleting them.
